rules: measurement modalities are never pooled as one absolute target
panel-level ranking and quantitative quotient losses share biological coordinates, not label scales
optimization data and population-confirmation evidence have separate gates
cross-source overlap is closed by publication or patent, target sequence, stereo ligand identity and endpoint
raw downloadable data are not redistributed until the exact artifact licence is verified
